scope: Per-leaf availability for legal partial data copies in bounded source-access discovery

contracts.snapshots: Independent typed leaf facts captured before later selector/argument effects; no live runtime references or target execution
contracts.copies: Assignments, private arguments and internal results preserve known cells alongside missing leaves; no private copyback or invented local inputs
contracts.returns: Matching resolved schemas merge only common availability/constants across live paths; frame cleanup does not erase captured data facts
contracts.conversions: Drop uncast constants across changed schemas; apply scalar capacity/domain facts and possible SHORT missing-state rules per copied leaf
contracts.guards: Unproven scalar reads, computed full-value consumers, geometric conversion and CONFIG-word packing retain explicit gaps; FILE/resource helper guards remain unchanged
contracts.inputs: Global aggregate source accesses remain candidates; unused missing fields may stay missing under existing runtime copy rules
contracts.bounds: Existing storage, analysis-step and schema limits; no unbounded fact graph or native memory model
contracts.persistence: Facts remain internal; existing plan/report/template/run formats and runtime copy behavior unchanged
contracts.boundary: Supported static source-access coverage only; no runtime readiness, target authenticity, native/compiler/controller equivalence claim
